title: VARCHAR
definition:
Casts a value to a VARCHAR type.
The function converts the column into a string representation with a specified maximum length.

title: INTEGER
definition:
Casts a value to an INTEGER type.
The function converts the column into a whole number by removing any decimal part if present.

title: BIG INTEGER
definition:
Casts a value to a BIGINT type.
This function converts the column into a large integer type used for handling bigger numeric values.

title: DECIMAL
definition:
Casts a value to a DECIMAL type.
The function converts the column into a numeric value that can include decimal precision.

title: DATE
definition:
Casts a value to a DATE type.
The function converts a timestamp or string into a date value, keeping only the date part (year, month, day).

title: TIMESTAMP
definition:
Casts a value to a TIMESTAMP type.
The function converts a date or string into a full timestamp value including date and time.

title: BOOLEAN
definition:
Casts a value to a BOOLEAN type.
The function converts the value into true or false depending on its representation (for example: 1 = true, 0 = false).
